ayahs.1: Bahut ba-barkat hai woh Allah Taala jis ne apne bande par Furqan utaara taake woh tamaam logon ke liye aagah karne wala ban jaaye.
ayahs.2: Isi Allah ki saltanat hai aasmanon aur zameen ki aur woh koi aulaad nahin rakhta, na us ki saltanat mein koi us ka saajhi hai aur har cheez ko us ne paida kar ke ek munaasib andaaza thehra diya hai.
ayahs.3: In logon ne Allah ke siwa jinhein apne mabood thehra rakhe hain woh kisi cheez ko paida nahin kar sakte balke woh khud paida kiye jaate hain, yeh to apni jaan ke nuqsaan nafa ka bhi ikhtiyaar nahin rakhte aur na maut-o-hayaat ke aur na dobaara jee uthne ke woh maalik hain.
ayahs.4: Aur kaafiron ne kaha yeh to bas khud isi ka ghada ghadaaya jhoot hai jis par aur logon ne bhi us ki madad ki hai, dar-asal yeh kaafir bade hi zulm aur sar-ta-sar jhoot ke murtakib hue hain.
ayahs.5: Aur yeh bhi kaha ke yeh to aglon ke afsaane hain jo us ne likha rakhe hain bas wahi subah-o-shaam us ke saamne padhe jaate hain.
ayahs.6: Keh dijiye ke use to us Allah ne utaara hai jo aasman-o-zameen ki tamaam posheeda baaton ko jaanta hai. Beshak woh bada hi bakhshne wala mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.7: Aur unhon ne kaha ke yeh kaisa Rasool hai? Ke khaana khaata hai aur bazaaron mein chalta phirta hai, us ke paas koi farishta kyun nahin bheja jaata? Ke woh bhi us ke saath ho kar daraane wala ban jaata.
ayahs.8: Ya us ke paas koi khazana hi daal diya jaata ya us ka koi baagh hi hota jis mein se yeh khaata. Aur in zaalimon ne kaha ke tum aise aadmi ke peechhe ho liye ho jis par jaadu kar diya gaya hai.
ayahs.9: Khayal to kijiye! Ke yeh log aap ki nisbat kaisi kaisi baaten banaate hain. Pas jis se woh khud hi behak rahe hain aur kisi tarah raah par nahin aa sakte.
ayahs.10: Allah Taala to aisa ba-barkat hai ke agar chaahe to aap ko bahut se aise baaghaat inaayat farma de jo un ke kahe hue baagh se bahut hi behtar hon jin ke neeche nehren lehrain le rahi hon aur aap ko bahut se (pukhta) mahal bhi de de.
ayahs.11: Baat yeh hai ke yeh log qayamat ko jhoot samajhte hain aur qayamat ke jhutlaane walon ke liye hum ne bhadakti hui aag taiyaar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.12: Jab woh unhein door se dekhegi to yeh us ka ghusse se bipharnaa aur dhaarnaa sunenge.
ayahs.13: Aur jab yeh jahannam ki kisi tang jagah mein mushkein kas kar phenk diye jaayenge to wahan apne liye maut hi maut pukaarenge.
ayahs.14: (Un se kaha jaayega) aaj ek hi maut ko na pukaaro balke bahut si amwaat ko pukaaro.
ayahs.15: Aap keh dijiye ke kya yeh behtar hai ya woh hameshgi wali jannat jis ka wada parhezgaron se kiya gaya hai, jo un ka badla hai aur un ke lautne ki asli jagah hai.
ayahs.16: Woh jo chaahenge un ke liye wahan maujood hoga, hamesha rehne wale. Yeh to aap ke Rabb ke zimme wada hai jo qaabil-e-talab hai.
ayahs.17: Aur jis din Allah Taala unhein aur siwaaye Allah ke jinhein yeh poojte rahe, unhein jama kar ke poochhega ke kya mere in bandon ko tum ne gumraah kiya ya yeh khud hi raah se gum ho gaye.
ayahs.18: Woh jawab denge ke tu paak zaat hai khud hamein hi yeh zeba na tha ke tere siwa auron ko apna karsaz banaate. Baat yeh hai ke tu ne unhein aur un ke baap dadon ko aasoodgiyan ata farmaayen yahan tak ke woh naseehat bhula baithe, yeh log the hi halaak hone wale.
ayahs.19: To unhon ne to tumhein tumhari tamaam baaton mein jhutlaaya, ab na to tum mein azaabon ke pherne ki taaqat hai, na madad karne ki. Tum mein se jis jis ne zulm kiya hai hum use bada azaab chakhayenge.
ayahs.20: Hum ne aap se pehle jitne Rasool bheje sab ke sab khaana bhi khaate the aur bazaaron mein bhi chalte phirte the aur hum ne tum mein se har ek ko doosre ki aazmaaish ka zariya bana diya. Kya tum sabr karoge? Tera Rabb sab kuchh dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.21: Aur jinhein hamari mulaaqaat ki tawaqqu nahin unhon ne kaha ke hum par farishte kyun nahin utaare jaate? Ya hum apni aankhon se apne Rabb ko dekh lete? In logon ne apne aap ko hi bahut bada samajh rakha hai aur sakht sarkashi kar li hai.
ayahs.22: Jis din yeh farishton ko dekh lenge us din in gunehgaaron ko koi khushi na hogi aur kahenge yeh mehroom hi mehroom kiye gaye.
ayahs.23: Aur unhon ne jo jo aamaal kiye the hum ne un ki taraf badh kar unhein paragandah zarron ki tarah kar diya.
ayahs.24: Albatta us din jannatiyon ka thikana behtar hoga aur khwabgah bhi umda hogi.
ayahs.25: Aur jis din aasman baadal samet phat jaayega aur farishte lagataar utaare jaayenge.
ayahs.26: Us din saheeh taur par mulk sirf Rahman ka hi hoga aur yeh din kaafiron par bada bhaari hoga.
ayahs.27: Aur us din zaalim shakhs apne haathon ko chaba chaba kar kahega haaye kaash ke main ne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki raah ikhtiyaar ki hoti.
ayahs.28: Haaye afsos kaash ke main ne fulaan ko dost na banaaya hota.
ayahs.29: Us ne to mujhe us ke baad gumraah kar diya ke naseehat mere paas aa pahunchi thi aur shaytaan to insan ko (waqt par) dagha dene wala hai.
ayahs.30: Aur Rasool kahega ke aye mere Parwardigar! Beshak meri ummat ne is Quran ko chhod rakha tha.
ayahs.31: Aur isi tarah hum ne har nabi ke dushman baaz gunehgaaron ko bana diya hai aur tera Rabb hi hidayat karne wala aur madad karne wala kaafi hai.
ayahs.32: Aur kaafiron ne kaha ke is par Quran saara ka saara ek saath hi kyun na utaara gaya. Isi tarah hum ne (thoda thoda kar ke) utaara taake is se hum aap ka dil qawi rakhen, hum ne ise thehar thehar kar hi padh sunaaya hai.
ayahs.33: Yeh aap ke paas jo koi misaal laayenge hum us ka sachcha jawab aur umda taujeeh aap ko bata denge.
ayahs.34: Jo log apne munh ke bal jahannam ki taraf jama kiye jaayenge. Wohi badtar makaan wale aur gumraah-tar raaste wale hain.
ayahs.35: Aur bila-shubha hum ne Moosa ko kitaab di aur un ke humraah un ke bhai Haaroon ko un ka wazir bana diya.
ayahs.36: Aur keh diya ke tum donon un logon ki taraf jaao jo hamari aayaton ko jhutla rahe hain. Phir hum ne unhein bilkul hi paamaal kar diya.
ayahs.37: Aur qaum-e-Nooh ne bhi jab Rasoolon ko jhoota kaha to hum ne unhein gharq kar diya aur logon ke liye unhein nishan-e-ibrat bana diya. Aur hum ne zaalimon ke liye dardnaak azaab muhaiya kar rakha hai.
ayahs.38: Aur Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon aur kuwen walon ko aur un ke darmiyaan ki bahut si ummaton ko (halaak kar diya).
ayahs.39: Aur hum ne un ke saamne misaalen bayan kin phir har ek ko bilkul hi tabaah-o-barbaad kar diya.
ayahs.40: Yeh log us basti ke paas se bhi aate jaate hain jin par buri tarah ki baarish barsaai gayi. Kya yeh phir bhi use dekhte nahin? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke unhein mar kar jee uthne ki umeed hi nahin.
ayahs.41: Aur tumhein jab kabhi dekhte hain to tum se maskhara-pan karne lagte hain. Ke kya yehi woh shakhs hain jinhein Allah Taala ne Rasool bana kar bheja hai.
ayahs.42: (Woh to kahiye) ke hum is par jame rahe warna unhon ne to hamein hamare maboodon se behka dene mein koi kasar nahin chhodi thi. Aur yeh jab azaabon ko dekhenge to unhein saaf maaloom ho jaayega ke poori tarah raah se bhatka hua kaun tha?
ayahs.43: Kya aap ne use bhi dekha jo apni khwahish-e-nafs ko apna mabood banaaye hue hai kya aap is ke zimmedar ho sakte hain?
ayahs.44: Kya aap isi khayal mein hain ke in mein se aksar sunte ya samajhte hain. Woh to nire chaupaayon jaise hain balke un se bhi ziyaada bhatke hue.
ayahs.45: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aap ke Rabb ne saaye ko kis tarah phaila diya hai? Agar chaahta to use thehra hua hi kar deta. Phir hum ne aftab ko us par daleel banaaya.
ayahs.46: Phir hum ne use aahista aahista apni taraf kheench liya.
ayahs.47: Aur wahi hai jis ne raat ko tumhare liye parda banaaya. Aur neend ko raahat banaayi. Aur din ko uth khade hone ka waqt.
ayahs.48: Aur wahi hai jo baran-e-rahmat se pehle khushkhabri dene wali hawaon ko bhejta hai aur hum aasman se paak paani barsaate hain.
ayahs.49: Taake us ke zariye se murda shehar ko zinda kar den aur use hum apni makhlooqaat mein se bahut se chaupaayon aur insanon ko pilaate hain.
ayahs.50: Aur beshak hum ne ise un ke darmiyaan tarah tarah se bayan kiya taake woh naseehat haasil karen, magar phir bhi aksar logon ne siwaaye na-shukri ke maana nahin.
ayahs.51: Agar hum chaahte to har basti mein ek daraane wala bhej dete.
ayahs.52: Pas aap kaafiron ka kehna na maanain aur Quran ke zariye un se poori taaqat se bada jihad karen.
ayahs.53: Aur wahi hai jis ne do samundar aapas mein mila rakhe hain, yeh hai meetha aur mazedar aur yeh hai khaari kadwa, aur in donon ke darmiyaan ek hijaab aur mazboot oot kar di.
ayahs.54: Woh hai jis ne paani se insan ko paida kiya, phir use nasab wala aur susraali rishton wala kar diya. Bila-shubha aap ka Parwardigar (har cheez par) qaadir hai.
ayahs.55: Yeh Allah ko chhod kar un ki ibaadat karte hain jo na to unhein koi nafa de saken na koi nuqsaan pahuncha saken, aur kaafir to hai hi apne Rabb ke khilaaf (shaytaan ki) madad karne wala.
ayahs.56: Hum ne to aap ko khushkhabri aur dar sunaane wala (nabi) bana kar bheja hai.
ayahs.57: Keh dijiye ke main Quran ke pahunchaane par tum se koi badla nahin chaahta magar jo shakhs apne Rabb ki taraf raah pakadna chaahe.
ayahs.58: Us hamesha zinda rehne wale Allah Taala par tawakkul karen jise kabhi maut nahin aur us ki tareef ke saath pakeezgi bayan karte rahen, woh apne bandon ke gunaahon se kaafi khabardaar hai.
ayahs.59: Wohi hai jis ne aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki sab cheezon ko chhe din mein paida kar diya hai, phir arsh par mustawi hua, woh Rahman hai, aap us ke baare mein kisi khabardaar se poochh len.
ayahs.60: In se jab bhi kaha jaata hai ke Rahman ko sajda karo to jawab dete hain Rahman hai kya? Kya hum use sajda karen jis ka tu hamein hukm de raha hai aur is (tableegh) ne un ki nafrat mein mazeed izaafa kar diya.
ayahs.61: Ba-barkat hai woh jis ne aasman mein burj banaaye aur is mein aftab banaaya aur munawwar mahtaab bhi.
ayahs.62: Aur isi ne raat aur din ko ek doosre ke peechhe aane jaane wala banaaya. Us shakhs ki naseehat ke liye jo naseehat haasil karne ya shukr-guzaari karne ka irada rakhta ho.
ayahs.63: Rahman ke (sachche) bande woh hain jo zameen par farotani ke saath chalte hain aur jab be-ilm log un se baaten karne lagte hain to woh keh dete hain ke salaam hai.
ayahs.64: Aur jo apne Rabb ke saamne sajde aur qiyaam karte hue raaten guzaar dete hain.
ayahs.65: Aur jo yeh dua karte hain ke aye hamare Parwardigar! Hum se dozakh ka azaab pare hi pare rakh, kyunke us ka azaab chimat jaane wala hai.
ayahs.66: Beshak woh theharne aur rehne ke lihaaz se badtareen jagah hai.
ayahs.67: Aur jo kharch karte waqt bhi na to israaf karte hain na bukhl, balke in donon ke darmiyaan motadil tareeqe par kharch karte hain.
ayahs.68: Aur Allah ke saath kisi doosre mabood ko nahin pukaarte aur kisi aise shakhs ko jise qatl karna Allah Taala ne mana kar diya ho woh bajuz haq ke qatl nahin karte, na woh zina ke murtakib hote hain aur jo koi yeh kaam kare woh apne oopar sakht wabaal laayega.
ayahs.69: Use qayamat ke din dohra azaab kiya jaayega aur woh zillat-o-khwaari ke saath hamesha isi mein rahega.
ayahs.70: Siwaaye in logon ke jo tauba karen aur imaan laayen aur nek kaam karen, aise logon ke gunaahon ko Allah Taala nekiyon se badal deta hai, Allah bakhshne wala mehrbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.71: Aur jo shakhs tauba kare aur nek amal kare woh to (haqeeqatan) Allah Taala ki taraf sachcha ruju karta hai.
ayahs.72: Aur jo log jhooti gawaahi nahin dete aur jab kisi laghv cheez par un ka guzar hota hai to sharafat se guzar jaate hain.
ayahs.73: Aur jab unhein un ke Rabb ke kalaam ki aayaten sunaai jaati hain to woh andhe behre ho kar un par nahin girte.
ayahs.74: Aur yeh dua karte hain ke aye hamare Parwardigar! Tu hamein hamari biwiyon aur aulaad se aankhon ki thandak ata farma aur hamein parhezgaron ka peshwa bana.
ayahs.75: Yehi woh log hain jinhein un ke sabr ke badle jannat ke buland-o-baala khaane diye jaayenge jahan unhein dua salaam pahunchaaya jaayega.
ayahs.76: Is mein yeh hamesha rahenge, woh bahut hi achchhi jagah aur umda maqaam hai.
ayahs.77: Keh dijiye! Agar tumhari dua iltija (pukaarna) na hoti to mera Rabb tumhari mutlaq parwa na karta, tum to jhutla chuke ab anqareeb is ki saza tumhein chimat jaane wali hogi.
